Hi Elena — thanks for the invite. Quick note: the calendar item arrived for our team but the Join button is missing for a few of us and the organizer field shows "orchid-sales+calendar@orchid.ai" instead of the user who created the meeting. Two problems we've seen with marketplace connectors:

- Guest join blocked when organizer is a service account (no host token)
- GCal strips the join button for some cross-domain organizer cases

Can you confirm whether the invite came from a marketplace connector or an automation? If so, could you resend the invite with a named organizer (or provide a direct Zoom link) so we can make sure the demo attendees can join?

We tried a quick workaround: ben opened the invite and couldn't see host controls. Screenshot attached. (Attachment: screenshot_join_missing.png (image/png)).

If easier, we can accept a Zoom link in the thread and use that as a bridge — happy to accept a separate Zoom link and update the calendar on our side.

Thanks,
